notes.subject: יראת
notes.rationale: יראת is 'fear/reverence'; rendered 'bikpela respek' — 'pret' alone would mislead.

notes.subject: קדשים
notes.rationale: Plural form 'holy ones/holy things': KJV 'the holy', JPS 'All-holy', YLT 'Holy Ones'; rendered 'ol samting holi'.

notes.subject: save/save tingting gut
notes.rationale: חכמה and דעת and בינה are three distinct wisdom-words; Tok Pisin uses 'save' twice, blurring the triad.

translation: Stat bilong save em i bikpela respek long Yahwe, na save bilong ol samting holi em i save tingting gut.
